== Summary ==

Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=97594 Star Wars Collectors Archive item 97594], [https://theswca.com/imgup/97594-1.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(89, 89, 670, 845)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>4c1e4e06bc9b3ba46d9498314561fda450b99f9474ff2d6e336c1c701eae56c2</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
